prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add an `import-csv` command requiring `--path`. CSV rows require a nonblank `Title`; `Description` is optional and `Status` may be blank, `pending`, or `completed`. Validate the entire file before changing storage, import valid rows with unique sequential IDs, and leave storage untouched if any row is invalid. Support `--json` with a stable summary containing imported count and IDs. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/import.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON imports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `IMPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

+            Assert-KnownOptions -Options $options -Allowed @('path', 'data-file', 'json')

+                if ($row.PSObject.Properties.Name -notcontains 'Title' -or
+                    [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$row.Title)) {
+                    throw "CSV row $rowNumber requires a nonblank Title."
+                }
+
+                $status = if ($row.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Status') {
+                    [string]$row.Status
+                }
+                else {
+                    ''
+                }
+                $status = $status.Trim()
+                if ($status -cnotin @('', 'pending', 'completed')) {
+                    throw "CSV row $rowNumber has invalid Status '$status'."
+                }
+
+                $validatedRows.Add([pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                    title = ([string]$row.Title).Trim()
+                    description = if ($row.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Description') {
+                        [string]$row.Description
+                    }
+                    else {
+                        ''
+                    }
+                    status = if ($status) { $status } else { 'pending' }
+                })
+            }
+
+            $tasks = @(Read-TaskStore -Path $dataFile)
+            $nextId = if ($tasks.Count -eq 0) { 1 } else { 1 + [int](($tasks | Measure-Object -Property id -Maximum).Maximum) }
+            $importedTasks = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
+            foreach ($row in $validatedRows) {
+                $importedTasks.Add([pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                    id = $nextId
+                    title = $row.title
+                    description = $row.description
+                    status = $row.status
+                    createdAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
+                })
+                $nextId++
+            }
+
+            if ($importedTasks.Count -gt 0) {
+                Write-TaskStore -Path $dataFile -Tasks @($tasks + $importedTasks.ToArray())
+            }
+            $ids = @($importedTasks | ForEach-Object { [int]$_.id })
+            $summary = [pscustomobject][ordered]@{
+                importedCount = $importedTasks.Count
+                ids = $ids
+            }
+            if ($asJson) {
+                Write-TaskForgeOutput -Value $summary -AsJson $true
+            }
+            else {
+                Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt')
+                "Imported $($importedTasks.Count) task(s). IDs: $($ids -join ', ')"
+            }
+        }

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $seed = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Existing', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($seed.ExitCode -eq 0) 'seed task should succeed'

    $validCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'valid.csv'
    @'
Title,Description,Status
Imported pending,First imported task,
Imported complete,,completed
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $validCsv
    $import = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $validCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($import.ExitCode -eq 0) 'valid CSV import should succeed'
    $importSummary = $import.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($importSummary.importedCount -eq 2) 'JSON import summary should contain importedCount'
    Assert-True (($importSummary.ids -join ',') -eq '2,3') 'JSON import summary should contain sequential IDs'
    Assert-True (-not $import.Output.Contains('IMPORT')) 'JSON import output should not contain the banner'

    $storedAfterImport = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($storedAfterImport.Count -eq 3) 'import should append every valid row'
    Assert-True ($storedAfterImport[1].status -eq 'pending') 'blank CSV status should default to pending'
    Assert-True ($storedAfterImport[2].status -eq 'completed') 'completed CSV status should be preserved'

    $invalidCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid.csv'
    @'
Title,Description,Status
Would otherwise import,Valid row,pending
Invalid status,Must roll back,blocked
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $invalidCsv
    $beforeInvalidImport = Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw
    $invalidImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $invalidCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($invalidImport.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid CSV import should fail'
    Assert-True ((Get-Content -LiteralPath $dataFile -Raw) -eq $beforeInvalidImport) 'invalid CSV import should leave storage untouched'

    $invalidCaseCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid-case.csv'
    "Title,Status`nWrong case,PENDING" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $invalidCaseCsv
    $invalidCase = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $invalidCaseCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidCase.ExitCode -ne 0) 'CSV status values should use the documented casing'

    $missingTitleCsv = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'missing-title.csv'
    "Description,Status`nNo title,pending" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $missingTitleCsv
    $missingTitle = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $missingTitleCsv, '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingTitle.ExitCode -ne 0) 'CSV rows without Title should fail'

    $bannerDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'banner-tasks.json'
    $bannerImport = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--path', $validCsv, '--data-file', $bannerDataFile)
    $banner = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt') -Raw
    $normalizedBanner = $banner.Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd("`n")
    Assert-True ($bannerImport.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON CSV import should succeed'
    Assert-True ($bannerImport.Output.StartsWith($normalizedBanner)) 'non-JSON import should display the banner first'
    Assert-True (([regex]::Matches($bannerImport.Output, 'TASKFORGE IMPORT')).Count -eq 1) 'non-JSON import should display the banner once'

    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt'))
    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/import.txt'))
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'import banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 })) 'import banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=-]+$' })) 'import banner should use only allowed ASCII characters'
    Assert-True (-not ($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' })) 'import banner should not contain trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True (($bannerLines -join "`n").Contains('IMPORT')) 'import banner should contain IMPORT'
    Assert-True ($bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and ($bannerBytes.Length -lt 2 -or $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10)) 'import banner should end with one newline'

    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('import-csv', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0) 'import-csv should require --path'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('import-csv --path PATH')) 'help should include import-csv'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
